tools.name: get_shopping_list
tools.description: Read the person's shopping list: each item's id, name, quantity, unit and whether it is checked.

tools.name: add_shopping_list_item
tools.description: Add one item to the person's shopping list. Give the name as the person said it; leave quantity and unit out when they gave none.

name.description: What to buy, as the person said it, such as "oat milk".

unit.description: The unit of the quantity, such as g, cups or cartons.

tools.name: set_shopping_list_item_checked
tools.description: Mark one item on the person's shopping list as bought (checked) or not bought. Take the id from get_shopping_list.

checked.description: true when the item is bought, false to put it back.

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Search the person's recipes by title. Returns each match's id and title.

tools.name: add_recipe_to_shopping_list
tools.description: Add every ingredient of one recipe to the person's shopping list. Take the recipe's id from search_recipes.

place_grocery_order.summary: list order: You can't place an order or pay for the person; only they can. Ask the person, who does it with Place order on the shopping list.

error.problem: You can't place an order or pay for the person; only they can. Ask the person, who does it with Place order on the shopping list
error.message: list order: You can't place an order or pay for the person; only they can. Ask the person, who does it with Place order on the shopping list.
